description:
Change one deck, sales page or social image that is ready, with one plain instruction, such as "translate it to German", "show prices in euros" or "swap the customer logo". Pass the asset's id and the instruction. When the instruction swaps a logo, pass the new logo's link as `logoUrl` for the account or `sellerLogoUrl` for your company.

Better Design makes a new asset with the same kind, brand and visual, and rewrites only the words the instruction asks to change. The original stays as it was. The edit gets the same check as a new asset; call get-asset with the new id to read it.

Each call spends 1 Better Design credit, less than a new asset, and returns the new asset's public links at once. It needs a Better Design account with a verified email.

id.description: The id of a ready asset that make-slides, make-sales-page, make-social-image or edit-asset returned.

instruction.description: What to change, in plain words, for example "translate it to German", "show prices in euros" or "swap the customer logo for the one at https://acme.com/logo.svg".

logoUrl.description: Optional. A link to the account's new logo image. Pass it when the instruction swaps the account's logo.

sellerLogoUrl.description: Optional. A link to your company's new logo image. Pass it when the instruction swaps your logo.

name: edit-asset
title: Edit an Asset
